dnet.cleanupHint: Networks you created without containers – no data is lost

dres.cleanup.cacheHint: Intermediate steps from building your own images

dres.cleanup.danglingHint: Images without a name, left over after updates
dres.cleanup.danglingText: Images without a name that no container uses are deleted.

dres.volumes.title: Volumes
